purpose: same-run end-to-end comparison of two-view surface reconstruction plus exact dynamic main-camera scissor repair against full Direct-HDR

source_references.moving_selection: only the two exact keyframes bracketing each query
source_references.states: only already logged physical/robot state rows; no synthetic trajectory samples

geometry.static_labels: fixed-camera static reference pixels with per-pixel temporal visibility
geometry.moving_labels: two bracketing source views projected with source-link to target-link SE3 and rasterized as same-label continuous surface triangles
geometry.visibility: nearest interpolated target depth across moving surfaces and observed static background; ambiguous ties remain unsupported
geometry.static_composition_semantics: compiled per-pixel equivalent of the NumPy prepared frontmost visibility and log-radiance interpolation; development output is compared against the prior NumPy candidate

radiometry.temporal_interpolation: log domain between observations of the same frontmost label and depth
